cast: Keep the same two original Taiwanese schoolchildren across all panels: A-Cheng, a 12-year-old boy with a round childlike face, short black hair and one small cowlick, white short-sleeved school shirt and dark navy bottoms; A-Xia, a 12-year-old girl with a neat ear-length bob, a small yellow hair clip, white short-sleeved school shirt and navy pleated skirt. Realistic cinematic Taiwanese school short film, warm natural light, horizontal 16:9 composition. No readable text, no logos, no watermark.

shots.panel: medium shot in a Taiwanese school corridor: A-Xia holds half a rice ball and looks shocked at A-Cheng, who does not recognize her
shots.visual_zh: 現在：阿夏拿著半顆飯糰，震驚地看著阿澄。

shots.panel: close-up of A-Cheng looking confused and taking a small step back from A-Xia
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄困惑地看著她，微微後退。

shots.panel: a quiet empty school corridor, simple title-card composition with empty space
A-Cheng stands beside a vending machine holding a returned test paper with red correction marks and two small star doodles on the back, no legible writing
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄看著有紅色批改痕跡、背面畫著兩顆星的舊考卷。

lines.caption: 阿澄：我想忘掉那次考試。

shots.panel: A-Xia walks up beside A-Cheng and points toward one softly glowing unlabeled soda bottle inside the vending machine
shots.visual_zh: 阿夏指向販賣機裡發亮、沒有標籤的汽水。

lines.text: 這瓶會讓你忘掉那整天，不只考卷。
lines.caption: 阿夏：這瓶會讓你忘掉那整天，不只考卷。

shots.panel: A-Cheng looks at A-Xia, then reaches toward the glowing bottle with a stubborn expression
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄看著阿夏，仍伸手拿汽水。

lines.text: 我只想忘掉考卷，不會忘掉妳。
lines.caption: 阿澄：我只想忘掉考卷，不會忘掉妳。

shots.panel: A-Cheng drinks from a plain unlabeled soda bottle; a soft amber glint crosses the frame and the two-star doodle on the paper falls out of focus
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄喝下汽水，暖色光閃過，考卷上的兩顆星失焦。

shots.panel: warm memory in the same corridor: A-Xia breaks a rice ball in half and offers one half to a downcast A-Cheng
shots.visual_zh: 回憶：阿夏把飯糰掰成兩半，遞給垂頭喪氣的阿澄。

shots.panel: A-Cheng accepts half the rice ball and looks up at A-Xia with a shy smile
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄接過半顆飯糰，抬頭看阿夏。

lines.text: 妳不怕我把衰運分給妳？
lines.caption: 阿澄：妳不怕我把衰運分給妳？

shots.panel: A-Xia points at the rice ball and tries not to laugh
close-up of two hands drawing two small stars on the back of the test paper beside the shared rice ball; the warm memory gently fades
shots.visual_zh: 特寫：兩人在考卷背面畫下兩顆星；回憶慢慢淡去。

shots.panel: back in the present corridor, A-Xia offers half a rice ball again and introduces herself kindly
shots.visual_zh: 回到現在：阿夏重新遞出半顆飯糰。

lines.text: 那我再介紹一次，我叫阿夏。
lines.caption: 阿夏：那我再介紹一次，我叫阿夏。

shots.panel: A-Cheng accepts the rice ball and gives A-Xia a polite nod
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄接過飯糰，禮貌地點頭。

shots.panel: A-Xia points at the two-star doodle on the back of the test paper and smiles softly
shots.visual_zh: 阿夏指向考卷背面的兩顆星。

lines.text: 這兩顆星，是我們第一次見面的記號。
lines.caption: 阿夏：這兩顆星，是我們第一次見面的記號。

shots.panel: A-Cheng looks from the two stars to A-Xia and smiles with tentative warmth
shots.visual_zh: 阿澄看看兩顆星，再看向阿夏。

lines.text: 我不記得那天，但我想重新認識妳。
lines.caption: 阿澄：我不記得那天，但我想重新認識妳。

shots.panel: A-Xia shares the remaining half of the rice ball; the two walk side by side down the sunlit corridor
shots.visual_zh: 阿夏把飯糰分他一半；兩人並肩走出走廊。

lines.caption: 阿夏：好，飯糰先分你一半。
